search_form_clear: Accessible name of the button that empties the project search field.
search_form_files_to_include: Accessible name of the include glob field of the project search.
search_form_files_to_include_or_skip: Button that shows the include and skip glob fields of the project search.
search_form_files_to_skip: Accessible name of the skip glob field of the project search.
search_form_find_in_project: Placeholder of the project search field.
search_form_include_src_ts: Placeholder of the include glob field: an example with two globs.
search_form_match_case: Tooltip and accessible name of the case-sensitive toggle of the project search.
search_form_regular_expression: Tooltip and accessible name of the regular expression toggle of the project search.
search_form_search_query: Accessible name of the project search field.
search_form_searching: Status line of the project search while it runs.
search_form_skip_dist_min_js: Placeholder of the skip glob field: an example with two globs.

search_form_status.description: Status line of the project search when it finished. {matches} and {files} are the counts that pick the plural; {matchesLabel} and {filesLabel} are the same numbers formatted, with a plus sign when the search stopped at its limit (100+). Zero matches reads No results.

search_form_took: How long the search took and which program ran it. {ms} is milliseconds, {tool} is rg or git.
search_form_whole_word: Tooltip and accessible name of the whole-word toggle of the project search.
search_parse_failed: Error line of the project search when ripgrep exited with an error and printed nothing. {code} is its exit code.
search_results_nothing_matches_query: Empty state of the project search when the query found nothing. {query} is what was typed.
search_results_search_every_file_in_this: Empty state of the project search before a query is typed.
search_results_search_results: Accessible name of the tree of project search results.
search_results_showing_the_first_results: Footer of the project search results when the search stopped at its limit.
search_results_try_fewer_words_turn_off: Advice under the nothing-matches state of the project search. Whole word is the toggle's name.
search_results_type_to_search_use_to: Hint under the empty state of the project search. {up}, {down} and {enter} are the key names.
